//: Operator scripts run under Node, not workerd. They are kept out of tsconfig.json on purpose: adding "node" to the Worker compilation would put process, Buffer, and the Node globals in scope for every Worker source file, and the one thing stopping a Worker module from reaching for them is that they do not typecheck. `npm run typecheck -w @patternlike/api` runs BOTH configs, so a script is checked without widening what the Worker can see.
